title: God Changed One Verb: Zakariyya, Maryam, and the Grammar of Two Miracles
excerpt: Two people ask God almost the same question seven verses apart. Both answers run word for word in parallel until the verb: God 'does' for Zakariyya, 'creates' for Maryam. The whole theology of how ʿIsa began sits in one substitution.
seo_title: Zakariyya and Maryam: One Verb Apart — Quran 3:47
seo_description: Seven verses apart in Aal-Imran, God answers two annunciations with one verb changed — 'does' for Zakariyya, 'creates' for Maryam. A close reading of how the Quran narrates the birth of ʿIsa.
